title: Iren targets 900MW data center campus in Wagga Wagga, Australia
key_facts: IREN has proposed a 900 MW data center campus near Wagga Wagga.
IREN runs an AI cloud platform across Australia and Canada and serves tenants such as Anthropic and Microsoft, per Simply Wall St.
Power for the site is not yet locked in and community approvals are only starting.
Analysts raise concerns about heavy capital spending and a short cash runway.
quote_evidence: The Wagga Wagga campus pushes that thesis into a new region where power is not yet locked in and community approvals are only starting.
why_it_matters_hint: An early-stage proposal for a very large campus.
